findings.description: Per-compound monitoring/STOP rules thin: monitoring only for metformin (B12); no red-flag STOP triggers for an operator already self-experimenting.
findings.required_fix: Add per-compound red-flag-stop triggers + monitoring markers (rapamycin fever/infection/non-healing-wound/dyspnea + glucose/HbA1c/CBC; metformin B12/lactic-acidosis; D+Q bleeding/syncope/effusion).

findings.description: PEARL 'fewer SAEs in rapamycin arms' is an un-guarded within-HALT reassurance an adversarial operator can quote to argue the HALT down.
findings.required_fix: Add paired 'underpowered single n=114/48wk trial; absence of signal != established safety; does not relax the HALT' clause + anti-pattern.

findings.description: goals.md hard-limit pointer missing: goal-agnostic library framing never tells the implementer the deployed agent must load+respect operator goals.md hard-limits at runtime.
findings.required_fix: Add a Context-Loading/Recommendation directive: deployed agent loads+respects goals.md hard-limits (no anabolic steroids; MD-gated experimental) at dispatch.

findings.description: Hormesis is never named as the dose-response frame for CR/exercise (the established levers).
findings.required_fix: Name hormesis as the dose-response frame in Synthesis & Insights.

findings.description: Sex differences appear only incidentally in two scattered numbers despite a male operator context downstream.
findings.required_fix: Surface the sex-difference caveat explicitly (rapamycin ITP M/F divergence; geroprotector animal effects often sex-dependent) as a named limitation.

findings.description: Body<->bibliography asymmetry: bib [32] (duplicate of Marcangeli) and [39] (cited only inside a compound bracket) registered as orphans.
findings.required_fix: Remove the [32] duplicate + renumber; split [39] out of the compound bracket so it resolves; restore exact body<->bib symmetry (Lesson 3 / AF-Y4).
